title: Dolphin Landings Charter Boat Center

services.name: view charters
services.desc: Our Back Bay Fishing trips are really a blast! Novices and pros alike rave about this unique Florida Salt Water Fishing experience, sometimes referred to as Flats Fishing. Back Bay boats are capable of operating in very shallow water in order to go right where the fish are! Fish for Snook, Tarpon, Redfish, Sea Trout, Cobia and Shark. The Tarpon run strong in Tampa Bay from May through early September, throughout Boca Ciega Bay Florida and surrounding Tampa Bay waters. There are numerous other species that can also be pursued using Fly rods in our area. Each vessel carries 1 to 4 guests and all your fishing gear is included. services.name: Sunset Trips
services.desc: Since 1972, hundreds of couples have sailed out to Boca Ciega Bay and taken their vows aboard our beautiful ocean yachts. Dolphin Landings offers pure romance on large luxury sailboats and spacious motor yachts. Whether you are planning a small and intimate occation or a lavish celebration, Dolphin Landings Charter Boat Center will tend to you and your guests every need. How about a romantic Island wedding a sunrise or sunset for just the two of you? Have a big wedding in mind? No problem we can provide 3 sailing yachts which can cover you entire party. services.name: Dolphin Watching
services.desc: Our captains can confidently tell guests they have a 99% chance they will see dolphins from our vessels. Are they that good? Well, yes … but they also know the deck is stacked in their favor. Boca Ciega Bay and the greater Tampa Bay area is home to over 700 healthy identified dolphins. Guests never tire of seeing them swimming along in their natural habitat. If you’re lucky, you may see them jump completely out of the water , After all, they like to look at you too! While guests occasionally spot dolphins just beyond our docks, the best way to truly experience the natural wonder of these wild sea creatures is on board one of our luxury sailing yachts and glide silently among them. blurb: Back in the early 1970’s, Captain Dan Peretz began taking guests out on his sail boat for one simple reason - so he could go sailing every day! Working directly off the beach near The Don Cesar Beach Resort… an idea was born to create a Full Service Charter Boat Center offering exceptional boating experiences on a wide range of yachts.

quotes.text: Decided to take my wife and our 5 month old out for a dolphin tour for our anniversary. This was my first time ever on a sailboat, and it was a GREAT TRIP! We had Captain Jack and first mate R.E (sp?), and they were both awesome! Both did a great job of handling the boat, and even with 18mph winds, it was a smooth and enjoyable trip! Highly recommend them, and we plan to do it again...

We went on the shelling cruise the other day while on vacation. So glad we did as it was the highlight of the trip! Tom and Jim were wonderful guides, funny and informative. Shell Key Island was beautiful and we loved that we had such a large amount of time to wander the island and collect shells. There are all kinds out there! Even got lucky and found a few sand dollars.

Jack and Roy were awesome on our 2 hour sailboat/ dolphin cruise….they were great and patient with everyone, we had a blast, it was so cool to be on a sailboat for the 1st time, definitely worth the time and money, we seen quite a few dolphins and got to feel the wind in the sails, thanks for a great time.

We had THE best time! Such a beautiful yacht and Captain Scott and Ari were so friendly and knowledgeable. We learnt about sailing and enjoyed Scott’s knowledge about the local area and wildlife. If you want to do a boat trip in and around St Pete Beach, this is the only one to book!

Just had our second trip with dolphin landings! It was another awesome experience. This time we got to take our daughters on their first time on a sailboat. Susie and Ari were great! Will definitely come back again the next time we visit st pete beach!!!

We did a sunset sail with Dolphin Landings and the captain and the girl who works there really took care of us! Wonderful experience and a must to-do if you ever visit the Tampa/St. Petersburg area. Sunset is amazing and you can bring your own alcohol!
